Proxy Kissed

Card Text:

Master: out-of-turn.

Put this card on a Giovanni when you move that Giovanni from your
uncontrolled region to your ready region during your influence phase.
This Giovanni gains one level of Potence [pot] and one level of
Fortitude [for]. His or her capacity is increased by 1. Move 1 blood
from the blood bank to this Giovanni.
